child_memory_note: Linux getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) maximum resident set, KiB; largest observed child process, not summed concurrent extractor memory or a per-document peak.
timing_note: Controller active durations exclude operator gaps. Worker duration contains pacing/network/local extraction/database. These timings overlap and must not be summed. Queue-wait sums are not elapsed processing time. See individual invocation and worker records.

1000.uncertainty: Planning estimate only. Format/OCR mix, discovery alias yield, source drift, retries and archive policy can materially increase costs. Access permission and separate execution authorization still required.

gap_note: Wall minus active invocations estimates controlled operator pauses and small process-boundary overhead; timestamps have second precision. This gap is not scraper processing time.
http_timing_note: HTTP callback wall includes socket time plus short response observation/hash/provenance work; it is not a pure network-only measure. PDF parse time already includes OCR time.
